label: KRemote
description: This extension for Karoo allows to use a remote to change screens remotely.
releaseNotes: Bells can now bypass the Karoo mute, so you hear them even with alerts silenced - turn it on in settings. Fixes auto-reconnect not arming after a restart, actions firing while you teach a button, and a held button chaining its double-tap action. Scanning for a remote no longer leaves the ANT radio searching, which saves battery.
